sources.title: Turn off this Meta setting before someone generates AI images of you
sources.snippet: Meta's new Muse Image tool lets anyone generate AI images of you from your public Insta profile. You won't be notified, and it's on by default.

sources.title: PolicyPilot — Your Insurance Policy, Scored by AI
sources.snippet: Get your free AI-powered insurance policy score in 60 seconds. PolicyPilot analyzes your home, auto, and renters coverage to find gaps, savings, and risks — no calls, no spam.

sources.title: Instagram is rolling out a controversial change to its AI policy
sources.snippet: Meta has announced its first image model along with an opt-out option for Instagram users who don't want their content regenerated by AI.

sources.title: My First AI Policy :: ~/myfirstaipolicy.com
sources.snippet: Answer a few questions, get a starter AI policy for your law firm or business. Free, open source (CC0), built from Falcon Rappaport & Berkman LLP's published templates. Not legal advice.
